summary: Lixiang Education filed Form 6-K disclosing the resignations of two independent directors (Teck Yong Heng and Yan Kit Lee) effective August 11, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement, and immediate replacement appointments on August 14, 2026. Jing Luo becomes audit and governance committee chair, and Yingyan Liang becomes compensation committee chair. The changes are routine board transitions and not abrupt or forced departures, but the filing primarily reports the changes with detailed bios. There is no deal involved, so the special-situation category is Management Changes, though this is a near-routine event.
